text: {"features":[{"name":"Role alignment","description":"How clearly the letter shows understanding of this specific security-engineering role and connects the applicant's background to its mission, responsibilities, and internal-platform context.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter frames interest in generic software or security terms with little or no reference to security automation, vulnerability response, agentic tooling, or enabling developer teams at scale."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions the role or company and touches one relevant theme, but the connection between past experience and the posted responsibilities remains broad or mostly aspirational."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter addresses several role themes such as secure development, automation, or foundational impact, but the case for fit is still general rather than tightly matched to this team."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly links past work and motivation to the team's mission of scaling security processes, helping developers, or building foundational tooling, showing solid understanding of the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes a precise, convincing case for this specific role by tying concrete prior experience to multiple posted responsibilities such as vulnerability handling, agentic tooling, Go back ends, Python agents, and developer-facing security enablement."}]},{"name":"Software experience depth","description":"How strong the letter's described track record is in testing, maintaining, and launching software products relative to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes only a near-minimum relevant record, typically a few years of work and a small number of production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter comfortably meets the baseline but shows a modest production record or limited evidence of repeated launch and maintenance ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid relevant experience through several years of work and multiple production services involving testing, maintenance, and launch responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong relevant experience through repeated full-lifecycle work on several production services over multiple years."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows especially strong relevant experience for this role through a sustained multi-year record and repeated testing, maintenance, and launches across many production services."}]},{"name":"Academic attainment","description":"The extent to which the letter presents formal technical education beyond the minimum qualification.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree or equivalent as the applicant's formal education baseline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree and also emphasizes strong formal computer-science grounding, but no graduate study."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents advanced graduate preparation as a clear strength of candidacy by explicitly using it to reinforce readiness for technically demanding systems, security, or AI work."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"How strongly the letter establishes depth with Go, the required implementation language for this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is mentioned only briefly or as one language among many, with no indication of depth or primary use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter states regular Go use but does not make clear that Go is a main implementation language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a common working language for back-end or service development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a principal or daily language used to build production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as the applicant's strongest language and shows substantial design or implementation ownership for important Go back-end systems."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"How strongly the letter establishes depth with Python for automation, tooling, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No Python experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned only briefly or as a secondary tool with no indication of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Python is described as a regular language for tooling, scripts, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Python is described as a significant production language used extensively for automation, services, or analysis."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Python is presented as production-grade and central to the applicant's work, with explicit evidence of robust tooling, services, or agent implementations."}]},{"name":"Applied AI","description":"How much concrete, production-relevant experience the letter shows with AI systems such as LLM-backed features or workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"AI is mentioned only aspirationally or in vague terms with no concrete work described."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building model-backed or LLM-based functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes shipping AI features in production with attention to evaluation, reliability, hardening, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial, role-relevant AI work that combines production deployment with clear evidence of trustworthy operation in real workflows."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates experience designing agent-based systems with explicit structure, controls, or guardrails.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic or autonomous-system work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter refers to agents or multi-step automation only abstractly, without describing actual design work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building or owning an agent system at a high level but gives limited architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete agent architecture, typically pairing agents with supporting services or controls."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes deliberate agent design with explicit boundaries, permissions, auditing, or guardrails, especially across Python agents and Go infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How much concrete experience the letter shows in automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related security workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No automation of vulnerability handling or triage is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter discusses security automation in general but gives no concrete example involving vulnerability workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions some automation around vulnerability reports or handling, but with limited detail on scope or change."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives a concrete example of classifying, routing, deduplicating, or prioritizing vulnerability reports to reduce manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes transforming a manual vulnerability workflow into a structured pipeline with clear operational impact such as routing, prioritization, deduplication, or self-serve handling."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on experience performing security assessments of systems, designs, or code.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions reviews or threat modeling only briefly, with unclear hands-on responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly describes participating in security assessments such as reviews, threat models, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes carrying out structured assessments and following through on remediation or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial assessment depth through repeated ownership, attacker-minded analysis, or broad cross-stack security review work."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates fluency with data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no meaningful evidence of data-structure or algorithmic ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims algorithmic strength in general terms but provides no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides a concrete example of using better data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives a strong example where algorithmic reasoning materially improved performance, correctness, or tractability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Algorithmic fluency stands out as a major strength of the application, supported by specific examples of redesigning core logic or transforming the behavior of an important system."}]},{"name":"Security validation","description":"The strength of independent signals that validate the applicant's security ability outside routine job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions no independent security signal such as certification, competition, or other outside validation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter offers a modest outside signal, such as occasional capture-the-flag participation or a baseline security certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter offers a sustained but moderate signal, such as regular capture-the-flag participation, serious practice, or a certification framed as deliberate skill-building."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter offers a strong outside signal, such as near-top capture-the-flag results or an advanced practical certification like OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter offers exceptional outside validation through multiple strong signals or a standout signal that clearly demonstrates advanced offensive or security capability."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"How much the letter shows ongoing contribution to or maintenance of open-source software used beyond the applicant's immediate team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source contribution is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions isolated patches or occasional contributions to open-source projects."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes recurring upstream fixes or regular contribution to external projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes maintaining an open-source project used beyond the applicant's own team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes sustained stewardship of a meaningfully used open-source project, including responsibilities such as review, releases, roadmap, or community support."}]},{"name":"Personal project ambition","description":"How much the letter's side projects demonstrate self-driven technical depth, scope, and appetite for hard engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No personal technical project is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small personal utility or hobby project with limited technical scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a side project that shows initiative and completion but only moderate technical complexity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a substantial personal project with clear systems or infrastructure complexity chosen to stretch technical ability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes an ambitious self-directed system that tackles hard distributed, reliability, storage, or coordination problems end to end."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter supports its claims with concrete, inspectable examples rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Most claims are generic assertions about ability or fit, with little concrete supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few examples, but many important claims remain broad or unsubstantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter supports several key claims with specific projects, tasks, or outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter grounds most major qualifications in concrete, role-relevant examples that make the claims easy to inspect."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is consistently evidence-based, using precise examples and outcomes to support nearly every important claim of fit."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How logically and persuasively the letter organizes its motivation, evidence, and fit into a clear overall case.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads as disconnected statements or a loose list of qualifications with little cumulative argument."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic structure but uneven flow, abrupt transitions, or unclear emphasis."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a coherent argument with understandable progression, even if some sections feel formulaic or loosely linked."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter builds a clear, persuasive narrative that connects motivation, experience, and fit in a logical order."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers an especially cohesive and memorable case in which the opening thesis, supporting examples, and closing all reinforce one another."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How clean, error-free, and professionally finished the writing is at the level of spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or typographical errors noticeably undermine professionalism or readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable mechanical errors are present, though the overall message remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few errors or awkward constructions appear, but the letter still reads as generally professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The writing is mostly clean and polished, with only minor slips that do not distract."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The writing is essentially error-free, smooth, and professionally finished throughout."}]}]}
